blocked_sentences: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except if this creature was embalmed, the token has no mana cost, it's white, and it's a Zombie in addition to its other types

needs.what: a card-level `embalm` cost (702.128): an activated ability usable only from the graveyard at sorcery speed whose cost is the printed mana plus exiling the card itself from the graveyard, and whose effect creates a token that is a copy of the card except it is white, has no mana cost and is a Zombie in addition to its other types; the token must remember it was embalmed so the card's own text can read it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `card_level_cost_keys` has no embalm/eternalize; `exile_self` as a cost requires the source on the battlefield, `graveyard_cost`/`flashback` cast the card rather than create a token copy of it, and `copy_permanent` copies a permanent on the battlefield, not a card in the graveyard, with no white/no-mana-cost/Zombie exception

needs.what: a `self_enters_as_copy` replacement (707.9) whose `except_` is conditional on the entering object being an embalmed token: if so, the copy's copiable values become white, lose their mana cost and add the Zombie subtype (707.9b), otherwise no exception; needs an `embalmed` condition plus `set_colors`, `no_mana_cost` and `add_subtypes` exception keys
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The packet's reference does not list `self_enters_as_copy` at all, and the engine's enters-as-copy exception keys (add_keywords, add_types, remove_supertypes, name, enters_with) have no colour, mana-cost or subtype override and no condition; a `self_enters` trigger with `become_copy` would make the copy a later effect rather than the entering object's copiable values
